items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Caffrey Darensbourg was working the Alley Club downtown, and he . . . I’d go to the club, and he’d see me out front by the bar. I was on long pants then, and he’d say, “Want to play a little while for me, man? Lay something on.”

ctx.x: Johnny Dave you were listening to?

Johnny Dave. Son Thomas was with Kid Rena. MacLean, Richard MacLean, great banjo player. George Guesnon. John Marrerro. Lawrence Marrerro. Caffrey Darensbourg was working the Alley Club downtown, and he . . . I’d go to the club, and he’d see me out front by the bar. I was on long pants then, and he’d say, “Want to play a little while for me, man? Lay something on.” I’d say, “Yeah.” So I’d go back. The band relished me, because I think I had a little more spark than he had. Then I was trying to impress them too.…
